name: Loot Goblin
description: Our BOSS RUSH JAM 2024 submission, You sit down after a long day of work and hop on your favorite game with your favorite friend. Fend off hoards of enemies in this retro-esque boss rush. The one catch is your friend is a chronic loot hoarder and it's gonna take more than a "please" to get them to share...
